name: Wash your hands on the surfaces that get missed
description: Wet, soap, and rub the backs, the gaps, the thumbs, and the fingertips, then rinse, dry, and turn the tap off with the towel.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Wash your hands on the surfaces that get missed.

levels.name: Cover the hands
levels.completion_criterion: Take off rings if you can, wet both hands, and add enough soap to cover them.
levels.safety_requirements: This follows the NHS handwashing page. It is not a treatment and it does not replace care for a wound.

levels.name: Rub the missed parts
levels.completion_criterion: Rub the backs, between the fingers, the thumbs, and the fingertips. Keep going for about twenty seconds, the timing the NHS page gives.
levels.safety_requirements: This follows the NHS handwashing page. It is not a treatment and it does not replace care for a wound.

levels.name: Rinse and close the tap
levels.completion_criterion: Rinse, dry your hands, turn the tap off with the towel, and name one reason this wash was due, such as food, the toilet, or an animal.
levels.safety_requirements: This follows the NHS handwashing page. It is not a treatment and it does not replace care for a wound.

safety_notes: This follows the NHS handwashing page. It is not a treatment and it does not replace care for a wound.

name: Fold a valley crease and leave it
description: Fold one edge to another so the crease bends toward you, and leave the fold in place.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Fold a valley crease and leave it.

levels.name: Match two edges
levels.completion_criterion: Fold one edge of a square to the opposite edge.
levels.safety_requirements: Use paper you may fold. The British Origami Society page shows this as the basic fold.

levels.name: Crease it
levels.completion_criterion: Flatten the crease so the fold stays where you put it.
levels.safety_requirements: Use paper you may fold. The British Origami Society page shows this as the basic fold.

levels.name: Name it
levels.completion_criterion: Point to the crease and say it is a valley fold, bent toward you.
levels.safety_requirements: Use paper you may fold. The British Origami Society page shows this as the basic fold.

safety_notes: Use paper you may fold. The British Origami Society page shows this as the basic fold.

name: Fold and unfold to leave a pre-crease
description: Make a valley fold, then open the paper so only the crease remains.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Fold and unfold to leave a pre-crease.

levels.name: Fold the edge
levels.completion_criterion: Fold one edge of the square to the opposite edge and crease it.
levels.safety_requirements: The same page calls this a pre-crease. It is not a finished model.

levels.name: Open it again
levels.completion_criterion: Open the paper until it lies flat.
levels.safety_requirements: The same page calls this a pre-crease. It is not a finished model.

levels.name: Show the line
levels.completion_criterion: Show the crease that remains, and say you are not using it yet.
levels.safety_requirements: The same page calls this a pre-crease. It is not a finished model.

safety_notes: The same page calls this a pre-crease. It is not a finished model.

name: Make a mountain fold by turning the paper over
description: Turn the paper over, make a valley fold, and turn it back so the crease bends away from you.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Make a mountain fold by turning the paper over.

levels.name: Turn the sheet
levels.completion_criterion: Turn the sheet over so the side you were looking at faces down.
levels.safety_requirements: The page says turning the paper over is the easier way. Do not force a closed sink.

levels.name: Valley-fold there
levels.completion_criterion: Fold the edge that matches the mountain line, as a valley fold, and crease it.
levels.safety_requirements: The page says turning the paper over is the easier way. Do not force a closed sink.

levels.name: Turn it back
levels.completion_criterion: Turn the sheet back. The crease now bends away from you.
levels.safety_requirements: The page says turning the paper over is the easier way. Do not force a closed sink.

safety_notes: The page says turning the paper over is the easier way. Do not force a closed sink.

name: Fold one pleat from a valley and a mountain
description: Put one valley crease beside one mountain crease so the paper steps.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Fold one pleat from a valley and a mountain.

levels.name: Make both creases
levels.completion_criterion: Pre-crease one valley and one mountain next to each other, then unfold.
levels.safety_requirements: The page says these creases are usually made one at a time, then combined. Use scrap paper.

levels.name: Combine them
levels.completion_criterion: Fold both creases at once so the paper steps over.
levels.safety_requirements: The page says these creases are usually made one at a time, then combined. Use scrap paper.

levels.name: Show the step
levels.completion_criterion: Show the pleat from the side so both layers and the step are visible.
levels.safety_requirements: The page says these creases are usually made one at a time, then combined. Use scrap paper.

safety_notes: The page says these creases are usually made one at a time, then combined. Use scrap paper.

name: Add the map legend's magnetic variation
description: After a bearing is set to grid north, rotate the housing by the variation printed in that map's legend.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Add the map legend's magnetic variation.

levels.name: Find the number
levels.completion_criterion: Find the magnetic variation note in the legend of the map you are using.
levels.safety_requirements: The Ordnance Survey guide says the variation changes and must be read from the map. This is not a mountain route.

levels.name: Turn the housing
levels.completion_criterion: With the baseplate still, rotate the housing by that amount in the direction the legend states.
levels.safety_requirements: The Ordnance Survey guide says the variation changes and must be read from the map. This is not a mountain route.

levels.name: Leave the bezel
levels.completion_criterion: Say you will not turn the housing again while you follow the arrow.
levels.safety_requirements: The Ordnance Survey guide says the variation changes and must be read from the map. This is not a mountain route.

safety_notes: The Ordnance Survey guide says the variation changes and must be read from the map. This is not a mountain route.

name: Move metal away before you read a compass
description: Put a phone, keys, or a knife aside, then see which end of the needle points north.
emoji_rationale: The symbol marks Move metal away before you read a compass.

levels.name: Set them aside
levels.completion_criterion: Put the phone and any knife or keys away from the compass.
levels.safety_requirements: The same guide says iron and steel deflect the needle. This does not by itself get you to a destination.

levels.name: Hold it flat
levels.completion_criterion: Hold the compass flat, away from a belt buckle.
levels.safety_requirements: The same guide says iron and steel deflect the needle. This does not by itself get you to a destination.

levels.name: Read the needle
levels.completion_criterion: Say which end points north, and do not trust the needle while the metal is still beside it.
levels.safety_requirements: The same guide says iron and steel deflect the needle. This does not by itself get you to a destination.

safety_notes: The same guide says iron and steel deflect the needle. This does not by itself get you to a destination.
